mapper.select: SELECT pd.id, pd.module_id, pd.data_name, pd.phone, pd.create_time, pd.scope_user_id, ofr.create_time AS last_time FROM crm_pre_drainage pd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY data_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) as rn FROM crm_on_follow_rel ) ofr ON pd.id = ofr.data_id AND ofr.rn = 1 WHERE pd.data_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{checkDTO.checkValue}, '%') ORDER BY pd.update_time DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM crm_pre_drainage WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
